posts.en:
dsh-token-viewer is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. CC Switch-style token consumption statistics for the dsh web GUI: per-request usage log, real-consumption hero, request-time-bucketed trend chart, per-model peak/off-peak list pricing, per-project and per-model stats, and account balance.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-3e759d3ff0e033c257c8.html
